source.title: NYC OTI Citywide Street Centerline (CSCL)
source.attribution: City of New York, Office of Technology and Innovation; NYC Open Data
source.filter: Constructed (status 2), boroughs 1-5, vehicular streets/highways/bridges/tunnels/ramps/alleys/U-turns. Excludes nonphysical streets, trails, ferries and nonvehicular segments.
source.modifications: Projected to local meters at centimeter precision; paved widths converted from feet; original centerline geometry and traffic directions retained. Whole road segments overlap cell boundaries and are deduplicated by ID at runtime.
source.limitations: Grade codes describe relative roadway levels, not measured elevations. Bridge/tunnel centerlines are present but height-separated navigation requires gameplay support. Surface materials are unspecified in CSCL; rendering is illustrative.
